prompt:
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet of CRYING WOLF armored BEAST form from the original 2008 PlayStation3 Metal Gear Solid4, matching the provided original-model and PS3 references as closely as possible. This is a game production sprite atlas, not a concept redesign. EXACTLY twelve full-body poses, arranged four columns and three rows, row-major. Every pose independently faces screen RIGHT. Keep all four armored mechanical legs, all paws, full railgun and tail cable entirely inside its own cell with wide transparent gutters. At least24px blank transparent margin at ALL sheet edges; no body pixels touch sheet edges, no neighboring poses touch. One actor in each cell. No text, grid lines, shadow floor, scenery or visual effects. True alpha background.
Faithful body: bulky LOW quadrupedal charcoal black/olive metal exosuit, rounded hump-like shoulder and hip shells, articulated four legs and elbow pistons, brown/bronze front lowerleg panels, broad mechanical paws, oval front robot sensor housing with tiny red and cyan lights, long flexible tail cable behind, one long rectangular dark original railgun mounted along upperback. Preserve model reference geometry. NO human upright torso, no ordinary wolf furry head, no human face, no dog fur, no generic robot soldier, no handheld sniper rifle, no added gun/laser. Detailed clean cel-shaded2D rendering consistent with original PS3 shapes, readable hard-edged silhouette, realistic body proportions. Keep torso body size constant across atlas; locomotion naturally changes limb positions, crouch shorter, airborne pose same size.
Twelve distinct animation poses, ALL face RIGHT: row1 (1) quadrupedal forepaw swipe startup retract near front paw, (2) swipe active stretch that paw toward RIGHT, (3) swipe recovery forepaw lands; (4) body-check startup torso leans back. Row2 (5) body-check active shoulder driven forward RIGHT, (6) body-check recovery all paws land, (7) low leg sweep startup one front paw tucked under, (8) low paw sweep active toward RIGHT. Row3 (9) low paw sweep recovery, (10) armored suit taking a hit forelegs buckled sensor still RIGHT, (11) falling to side whole body and all four legs complete, (12) inert fully armored side fallen body tail and all paws inside cell. No human fists, no humanoid kicks; simulate mechanical quadrupedal body hits. The poses are normal nongory versus animation adaptations. No sparks or weapon effects. Maintain fourlegs and full armored identity in ALL cells, no shell loss or Beauty.
